name: task-controller
description: Task boundary planning plus KY-TASK controller protocol for gated multi-lane Codex execution.

interface.shortDescription: 任务定界 + lane / worker 总控执行。
interface.longDescription: KY-TASK bundles task-boundary-planner with a controller protocol and runtime adapter: lock a task contract, compile one semantic owner and an explicit OrchestrationPlan, separate parallel waves from justified serial edges, match capabilities per lane, govern high-impact commercial decisions, preserve Codex project affinity, create project-scoped native Session workers for dependency-ready batches, ingest corrections, preserve write boundaries, record callbacks, and independently verify final outputs.
defaultPrompt: 用 KY-TASK 先定任务边界，再严格编排 semantic owner、主路径、并行波次、串行原因和逐 Lane 能力，通过后才创建 Session。
继续执行下一条已批准的 lane。
按 KY-TASK 契约检查这次执行有没有跑偏。
